video_title: RJ Barrett | Post Game at Philadelphia 76ers | November 12, 2026

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the Raptors' need for collective effort
quotes.excerpt: Everybody has to step up, including us. Right now it's been tough. We just got to figure it out.
quotes.quote: Everybody has to step up, including us. Right now it's been tough. We just got to figure it out. I think we're starting to play games off better. We're putting ourselves in a good position where we're actually getting out to big leads. We just have to sustain those and figure out how to win.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on the Raptors recent struggles: Everybody has to step up. We are putting ourselves in a good position where we are actually getting out to big leads. We just have to sustain those and figure out how to win.

structured.context: RJ Barrett discusses the need for the Raptors to maintain leads and improve their collective effort after a game against the Philadelphia 76ers.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the challenge of sustaining leads
quotes.excerpt: We're putting ourselves in a good position to win these games. We just got to go back to the film.
quotes.quote: We're putting ourselves in a good position to win these games. We just got to go back to the film, sustain it. Little key moments, I would say, that were letting teams get these runs. But it's a long season and we'll continue to get better at that.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett says the Raptors are looking at film to address their late game issues: Little key moments I would say that were letting teams get these runs. But it is a long season and we will continue to get better at that.

structured.context: RJ Barrett explains that the team needs to review film to identify the key moments where they allow opponents to go on runs.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on bouncing back from a tough schedule
quotes.excerpt: Got to bounce back. Those don't really matter, back-to-back or not. You got to find a way, find energy.
quotes.quote: Got to bounce back. Those don't really matter, back-to-back or not. You got to find a way, find energy to do it. We put ourselves in a good position against a good team, and we'll figure it out.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on playing through a tough schedule: Got to bounce back. Those do not really matter, back to back or not. You got to find a way, find energy to do it.

structured.context: RJ Barrett comments on the team's need to find energy and bounce back despite the challenges of a difficult schedule.
